owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: A user connects the local directory/directories and GitHub repository scope required for the project.
The user connects the supported services and grants the access they want Memev to have. They are not asked to allocate agents or select execution resources.
The user describes the desired outcome and scope in the lead-agent prompt.
Memev clarifies material ambiguity, assumptions, constraints and acceptance criteria, then presents the proposed scope for approval.

Memev decomposes the approved scope into contracts, deliverables, a project brief, roadmap, integrated project plan, development plan, system architecture, subsystem architecture as needed, work breakdown structure and dependency graph.
The user reviews the project definition and approves it. The state machine takes over execution.

Memev internally selects eligible resources, dispatches work, manages dependencies, handles provider/session failures, retries or reallocates work where policy permits, and records actual execution events.
The workspace reflects factual project progress and makes generated documents, diagrams and previews available with verification state.
A genuine blocker requiring human judgement is raised; the lead agent explains options, records the user's choice and updates affected work.
Interrupt an execution resource and confirm Memev recovers or reallocates work without asking the user to manage the agent.
Revoke a required permission and confirm Memev safely pauses or reroutes affected work, then asks the user only if a new grant is necessary.
Introduce a failed verification and require repair.
Change scope and confirm affected roadmap items, plans, architecture, tasks, approvals and evidence are updated or marked stale.
Reconcile a conflicting edit without silently losing work.
Produce a final report linking delivered artefacts, checks, evidence, decisions and outstanding limitations.
Repeat with different provider and machine configurations. Record which steps are automatic, policy-gated or genuinely require human intervention.

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
